column4: The shipped toolchain-report accepts native GHCup and GHC by their declared version requirements, with no toolchain digest pin, signature, archive, operating-system, architecture, or device prerequisite. Two observations agree on versions; the independent oracle judges version boundaries, actual missing/malformed/failed tools, retained decoder/simulator/codegen/provenance probes, and pure planning from supplied platform fixtures. The runner plants a nonce and requests an unsupported compiler version, which the shipped binary reports as refused. Builds remain serial. Compiler correctness and publisher identity remain assumptions.
